IMPORTANT — Please read before using this tool

This playbook is a reference tool to help operators quickly assess congestion as it happens in real time. Use it to build situational awareness around constraints you're seeing on screen — not as a hard trigger or automated signal.

The shadow pricing, shift factors, and MCC estimates here are derived from a specific historical study period (Apr 2025 – May 2026). Values shown are approximations based on the best information available at the time of analysis.

Nodes, shift factors, and priority designations should be treated as starting points — not hard numbers.

Transmission outages, new generation interconnections, seasonal load shifts, and topology changes mean the grid you're operating today may respond differently than the grid used in this analysis. A constraint that behaved predictably in the past may not behave the same way every night.

ALWAYS reference current outage conditions before acting. TOPOLOGY IS CONSTANTLY CHANGING.

This tool is only as good as the information we put into it. If you observe new patterns, updated line behavior, or anything that doesn't match what you're seeing — add a note. The Operator Notes column is the most valuable part of this sheet over time.

1.  See congestion on a line → find it in the Line Lookup tab
2.  Check Priority: 🟢 Active  |  🟡 Watch  |  ⚫ Low Priority
3.  Review Peak HE, Driver, and Primary Node & SF
4.  Jump to seasonal tab (Summer/Fall/Winter/Spring) for that season's top lines
5.  Use the MCC Calculator tab to compute your site's real-time MCC from a shadow price
6.  Add observations to Operator Notes for the next shift
